title: Azadi Tower
summary: The Azadi Tower in Tehran, designed by Hossein Amanat, is about 45 m high and 64 m wide. A national design competition was held in 1967 and the monument opened in 1972 as the Shahyad Tower. ArchDaily gives a 1966 competition and 1971 completion. It is built of poured concrete clad in white marble.

uncertainty.note: VisitIran: competition 1967, operation 1972. ArchDaily: competition 1966, completion 1971. The span follows VisitIran.
